approach: Remove the producer's full-suite requirement at its origin: the prompt line (producer.md), the `ran_full_tests`/`tests_missing` gating and its send-back text in `produce_and_verify` (run.rs), and the verifier-facing "run the full suite" wording in the producer-report-gaps note. Keep the unmet-criteria send-back, `PRODUCER_SEND_BACKS`, and all post-producer checks and verdict logic untouched. Rewrite the lifecycle and job_plan tests to the new behavior. Add D113 to decisions.md with forward pointers on D95 and D103, amend athena-v0.md B.2 and line 772, and add CHANGELOG entries (a D113 entry, and a supersession note on the kept D95 entry). The prompt says to use targeted tests while working and to run the full suite at most once.

decisions.choice: Delete `ran_full_tests`, `FULL_TEST_COMMAND`, `enforce_tests` and `tests_missing`; the loop breaks when `unmet` is empty. Keep `PRODUCER_SEND_BACKS` and the unmet-criteria send-back text.
decisions.reason: The gate is the root cause of repeated 9 to 11 minute suite runs (job nvbb ran it six times and hit its 1800 s deadline). Athena already runs fmt, clippy and the full test on the candidate. Removing every use avoids dead-code warnings under -D warnings.

rejected.option: Keep the gate but allow targeted tests
rejected.why: Still sends back and costs a producer run.
The code would still send back a report lacking the result, so the rule would stay in force.

decisions.choice: Reword the producer-report-gaps note to say the listed items were not confirmed and the verifier should judge them, citing recorded check results instead of running the full suite.
decisions.reason: Criterion 2 requires the note no longer tell the verifier to run the full suite; this matches the verifier prompt's cite-recorded-results rule, which stays unchanged.

rejected.why: Unmet-criteria gaps still need to reach the verifier (D103).

decisions.choice: Producer prompt: run targeted `cargo test -p <crate> <filter>` while working; Athena runs fmt, clippy and the full suite on the candidate; the producer may run the full suite at most once. Report only checks actually run.
decisions.reason: Matches the user's reply and shortens the prompt.

rejected.why: The user said at most once, not never.

decisions.choice: fake.rs stops reporting a passing `cargo test --locked`; outputs.rs gets a doc comment on `checks_run` saying to list only checks actually run.
decisions.reason: The fake's claim existed only to satisfy the removed gate; the doc comment states the new rule at the type.

rejected.why: It would keep encoding the old requirement in test scaffolding.

decisions.choice: Docs: new D113 after D112 stating once that earlier text stays as history, with figures. One-line pointers under D95 and D103. Keep the CHANGELOG D95 entry with a supersession note. Edit athena-v0.md in place.
decisions.reason: Criteria 6 to 8 and the user's reply: keep old entries and supersede with a pointer. athena-v0.md is a current design doc.

rejected.why: Out of scope and loses history.

files.purpose: Replace the full-suite line with targeted-tests guidance; Athena runs fmt, clippy and the full suite; the suite at most once.
Remove the full-suite gating and send-back text; keep the unmet-criteria send-back; reword the producer-report-gaps note; fix comments.
Rewrite the full-test tests to the new behavior; keep the unmet-criteria tests.
Trigger the send-back with an unmet criterion instead of a missing full-suite check.
Add D113 and forward pointers on D95 and D103.
Remove the full-suite requirement at line 772 and in B.2.
Add the D113 entry and a supersession note on the kept D95 entry.
The fake producer no longer reports a passing full suite it did not run.
Doc comment on `ProducerOutput::checks_run`: list only checks actually run.

steps: Edit producer.md: replace the full-suite line with the targeted-tests instruction, state that Athena runs fmt, clippy and the full suite on the candidate, and say the producer may run the full suite at most once. Keep the criteria_check line.

Edit run.rs: delete FULL_TEST_COMMAND, ran_full_tests, enforce_tests and tests_missing. Make the loop break when `unmet.is_empty()`. Build `problems` from `unmet` only. Remove the test send-back text. Update the comments above the loop and the PRODUCER_SEND_BACKS doc. Reword the producer-report-gaps note to drop the run instruction.
Edit fake.rs so the fake report no longer claims a passing full suite; add the doc comment on `checks_run` in outputs.rs.

Edit lifecycle.rs: the not-run test becomes one producer run with no 'sent back' line; the missing-check tests are rewritten the same way; a `fail` result still goes on; a no-change run fails with 'made no change'. Keep the unmet-criteria tests.
Edit job_plan.rs: the first report marks one default criterion unmet, as `unmet_criterion_report` does in lifecycle.rs, and the second is complete. Update the comment near line 119.

Edit decisions.md: add pointers under D95 and D103, and D113 after D112 in the file's format, with the figures (nvbb six runs, 1800 s, 9 to 11 minutes). State once that earlier text stays as history, and that it amends D95 and D103.
Edit athena-v0.md line 772 and the B.2 paragraphs so checks_run lists checks run, there is no full-suite requirement, and the send-back covers criteria only.
Edit CHANGELOG.md: add the D113 entry under [Unreleased] and a supersession note on the kept D95 entry.
Run cargo fmt --all --check, cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings, cargo test --locked, and the criterion 8 Grep; report the results.

risks.risk: Existing tests outside the two named files assume a send-back for a missing full-suite check.
risks.mitigation: Grep crates/ for 'full test', 'sent back' and 'cargo test --locked' before editing, and run `cargo test --locked -p athena-core`. run_pin_tests.rs near 759 uses an unmet-criteria send-back.

risks.risk: The reworded gaps note breaks tests that assert on its content.
risks.mitigation: Keep `report_gaps` unchanged; only the note text is reworded. Lifecycle tests assert on the 'producer-report-gaps' name and the unmet criterion text.

risks.risk: An unused import or constant is left behind and -D warnings fails.
risks.mitigation: Grep crates/ for each removed name and run clippy.

risks.risk: A leftover statement of the old rule in the docs (criterion 8).
risks.mitigation: Grep the three docs for the three phrases at the end and cite the output; keep old phrases inside D95, D103 or the supersession notes.

risks.risk: The doc comment in outputs.rs changes the generated JSON schema and trips a schema test.

demonstrations.method: Read the diff and grep the file for the old wording.
demonstrations.observes: The old line (run the full `cargo test --locked`, `not-run` not acceptable) is gone. In its place: run targeted `cargo test -p <crate> <filter>` while working, and Athena runs fmt, clippy and the full suite on the candidate. A Grep for 'full `cargo test --locked`' in the file returns nothing.

demonstrations.method: Diff run.rs and grep for the removed names.
demonstrations.observes: `ran_full_tests`, `FULL_TEST_COMMAND`, `enforce_tests`, `tests_missing` and the full-suite send-back text are removed. The unmet-criteria send-back remains. The producer-report-gaps note has no instruction to run the full suite.

demonstrations.method: Show that the diff touches no check or verdict code and that the verifier prompt is unchanged.
demonstrations.observes: No change under the check or verdict code, and none to crates/athena-cap-change/prompts/verifier.md, which still says to cite recorded results.

demonstrations.method: Run the rewritten lifecycle tests, then the job_plan tests, as two commands in a single demonstration. Lifecycle covers: a `not-run` report and a report with no full-suite check (one producer run, no send-back, verifier reached); an unmet criterion (two producer runs, sent back once); an unmet criterion still unmet (verifier gets producer-report-gaps); a recorded failing test check (rejected). job_plan's send-back test now triggers the send-back with an unmet criterion.
demonstrations.command: cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test lifecycle && cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test job_plan
demonstrations.observes: Both test binaries pass. Producer call count is 1 for the not-run and missing-check reports and 2 for unmet criteria. The failing-test-check case is still rejected. The job_plan second prompt has '## Sent back' and the plan section, and the hash matches the plan record.
demonstrations.fails_without: With the gating still in place, the not-run test would see 2 producer calls and a 'sent back' line and fail. If the unmet-criteria send-back were removed, the 2-call tests in lifecycle and job_plan would fail. If a failing test check no longer rejected, the rejection test would fail.

demonstrations.observes: Both exit 0 with no warnings, including no unused constant, function or import from the removed gating.
demonstrations.fails_without: If `FULL_TEST_COMMAND` or `ran_full_tests` were left unused, clippy would report dead code and exit non-zero.

demonstrations.observes: A new '## D113' after D112 amends D95 and D103, says once that the earlier text stays as history, and gives the figures: job nvbb ran the suite six times, hit its 1800 s deadline, and a run takes 9 to 11 minutes. D95 and D103 each get a one-line pointer to D113.

demonstrations.method: Read the diff of CHANGELOG.md and athena-v0.md.
demonstrations.observes: CHANGELOG [Unreleased] keeps the D95 entry and adds a note that D113 supersedes it. A new D113 entry gives the same reason and figures. athena-v0.md line 772 and the B.2 paragraphs no longer say the producer must run the full suite or that a second miss fails the job.

demonstrations.method: Run the Grep tool with pattern 'full `cargo test --locked`|second miss|ran_full_tests' over docs/decisions.md, docs/design/athena-v0.md and CHANGELOG.md, output_mode content, and cite the command and output.
demonstrations.command: Grep tool: pattern 'full `cargo test --locked`|second miss|ran_full_tests', paths docs/decisions.md docs/design/athena-v0.md CHANGELOG.md, output_mode content
demonstrations.observes: Every hit is in D95 or D103 history, D113 text quoting it, or a 'superseded by D113' note. athena-v0.md has no hit. No hit states the requirement as current.

open_questions: Whether token-budget or schema tests react to the producer prompt change or the new `checks_run` doc comment; the producer should run the athena-context tests.
Whether other tests (for example run_pin_tests.rs near line 759, or other crates) rely on the fake producer's passing `cargo test --locked` report; the producer must grep and run them.
The CHANGELOG D103 'Fixed' entry mentions the verifier being told whether the full test result was missing. It is not a grep-8 phrase; I would leave it as history.
